div.head: II Cn 15a
div.ab: ⁊ gyf hwa þæne friðleasan man healde oððe flyman feormie, bete þæt, swa hit ær lagu wæs.
And gif hwa þonne fryðleasan man healde oððe feormige, bete þæt, swa hit ær lagu wæs.
Si quis hominem pro culpa exiliatum tenuerit aut pauerit, emendet hoc, sicut ante legitimum fuit.
⁊ gyf hwá ðonne friðleasan man healde oððe feormie, bete swa hit lagu wǽs.
And gyf hwa þæne friðleasan man healde oððe flyman feormie, bete þæt, swa hit ær lagu wæs.
Und wenn jemand den (nun einen BA?) friedlosen Menschen [schützend] erhält oder (einen Verbannten G) beherbergt, büsse er das, wie es bisher Rechtsordnung war.
And if anyone keeps the (then an, B A?) outlawed man [under protection] or harbours (an outlaw, G), let him pay compensation for it as was the law before.
And therefore if anyone maintains or harbours an outlawed man, he shall make amends in accordance with the established law.
And if then anyone maintains or harbours an outlawed man, he is to pay compensation for it as the law was before.
And accordingly, if anyone protects or shelters an outlaw, he shall be penalized according to the law.
div.note: G's ‘flyman’ is probably G's addition. Liebermann compares II Ew 5.2.
The Nero version inserts “or a fugitive”.
